summary: Exact candidate commit b6797a2b4acad47e97629129cd30378115c55395 fixes all concrete counterexamples reported by review PR https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2986 and its focused regression and affected unit suite pass. It remains a partial implementation of the original common-test-entry contract: the new repeated-ID guard excludes unit paths from its uncentralized-ID scan and recognizes only model_id/model_path keyword arguments plus three resolver calls. Consequently, real model IDs repeated between runnable server cases and ordinary unit fixtures remain hard-coded and the regression passes. Request changes to cover or explicitly classify these non-vector fixtures rather than treating the candidate as a full fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction found exactly 20 hard-coded occurrences of existing shared constants in the non-unit executable tree and exactly the reviewed 4/2/2/2 occurrences of LTX-2.3, LTX-2, FastHunyuan, and LongLive2. Raw output: /job/review_evidence/j-7f7c15d21cec/base_failure.log

At exact candidate commit b6797a2b4acad47e97629129cd30378115c55395, all three candidate regression tests passed, including known constants, repeated model-selection arguments, and docstring handling. The imported sglang path was /job/repo/python/sglang/__init__.py.

tests.what_was_measured: Confirmed that Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4 is detected when server/gpu_cases.py and unit/test_ideogram4.py are both scanned but disappears under the candidate's unit-tree filter. Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers and FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-4-step-Preview-v1-VSA-DataFree also remain repeated while using unrecognized _get_config_info or assignment forms. Synthetic fixtures independently reproduced both blind spots. Raw output: /job/review_evidence/j-7f7c15d21cec/adversarial_guard.log

At the exact candidate, 323 tests and 50 subtests passed across Sana-WM, Cosmos3, LTX, OpenAI utilities, Sana Video, VAE loading, video profiling, and web UI tests. Raw output: /job/review_evidence/j-7f7c15d21cec/affected_unit_tests.log
The candidate's Python test tree compiled with the prepared interpreter; no native extension was involved.

gpu_execution.evidence: The candidate changes test identifiers and an AST policy only; it changes no inference or numerical implementation. Running unrelated one-GPU inference would not validate the source-refactor contract. The assigned environment is ROCm 7.2 with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; Ascend and MUSA paths are unavailable, and the touched DP serving case requires two GPUs.

remaining_counterexamples: Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4 remains hard-coded in server/gpu_cases.py and unit/test_ideogram4.py. The helper detects the pair if both files are supplied, but the production regression excludes the unit occurrence and reports no repetition.

Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers remains hard-coded in server/gpu_cases.py and unit/test_ltx2_5_config.py. The unit occurrence is excluded and uses _get_config_info, which is not among the recognized resolver names.

FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-4-step-Preview-v1-VSA-DataFree remains hard-coded in server/gpu_cases.py and as FASTH3_MODEL_ID in unit/test_minimax_h3_fasth3.py. Plain assignment fixtures are not recognized by the uncentralized-ID detector and the unit tree is excluded.

The new-ID policy still blanket-excludes ordinary unit fixtures rather than distinguishing intentional parser/config vectors from reusable model fixtures, so future cross-tree repetitions can evade the guard.
remaining_limitations: No GPU numerical claim was made because no inference code changed and relevant model weights were not needed for this source-identity review.
Ascend and MUSA runtime imports/cases could not be executed on the ROCm host; their source compiled and identifier substitutions were inspected.
The two-GPU data-parallel serving case was not executed because the task assigned one GPU.
No C, C++, HIP, CUDA, or other native source changed between the base and candidate; repository-environment.json reports no prepared native artifact, so native rebuild was not applicable.
Raw review evidence was preserved outside the checkout under /job/review_evidence/j-7f7c15d21cec while revisions were switched.
